name: r2t2
diagnosis: Many wheel_saturation policy-induced cases show leak plus friction momentum buildup with SAFE/NOMINAL cycling. Policy resumes to NOMINAL while wheels remain near max, then NOMINAL demand pushes an in-use wheel over 98% for >60s, while no-policy 4-wheel control tolerates it.
rationale: Add momentum guard just below violation level: in-use wheel >=97% for 60s forces SAFE sun-point and blocks resume while above. Sun-point needs lower torque than NOMINAL tracking, limiting further momentum buildup and pre-empting the 98% for 60s violation. Mirrors violation definition so only near-saturation runs are affected.
why_no_regressions: 97% for 60s is far above normal operation; nominal and single-fault runs never dwell there. Guard only adds SAFE dwell in runs already near saturation and never forces early NOMINAL, so no new attitude or battery violations.
gate_reason: rejected (strict): 2 new violations in 2 runs (1 previously clean) vs 26 fixes on the full suite

gate_legacy_cumulative.gate_reason: rejected: 1 new violations in 1 runs (0 previously clean) vs 13 fixes on the full suite
